doc.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Hearing loss and protecting ears
summary: Wears a hearing aid; blames years beside the brass and advises young musicians to wear earplugs.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I was telling Monk I’ve been wearing a hearing aid for about the last five years and yesterday it conked out on me, so everything sounds a little—
It’s not a good place to have things conk out on you.

Well I don’t have a terrible problem, it’s just like over the years of playing with brass in the ears, a lot of the high frequencies have gone, and I’d like to advise all young musicians to protect your ears a little better than I did all those years, like put earplugs in if you’re in a real noisy situation. I sat right next to Gene there, and the trumpets right in back of you all the time, and I think it might have had something to do with it. And heredity probably has something to do with it too.
